clips.title: The story
paras: Je'neu Sancrea is a Darkspear troll and a member of the Earthen Ring stationed at Zoram'gar Outpost along the Ashenvale coast. Sensing dark disturbances deep beneath the shoreline, he directs Horde adventurers to investigate the corruption infesting the ancient submerged temple of Blackfathom Deeps.

While most of the Earthen Ring focuses on elemental harmony across Kalimdor, Je'neu Sancrea keeps watch over the secluded and dangerous Zoram Strand. Perched at Zoram'gar Outpost, he observes the dark tremors and unnatural tides stirring near the ruined temple of Blackfathom Deeps. Though bound by the shamanic duties of his circle, his strong loyalties to the Darkspear tribe and Thrall's Horde keep him working exclusively alongside Horde champions.
